Goal: give Student enough to infer rule. We should include diverse colors, border positions/sizes, patterns. The verifier simply swaps the two interior non-5 non-0 colors. Note: if interior has only two colors. Border itself 5 unchanged. Outside unchanged.

Let's create maybe 4-6 examples. Need call show_transformed_input for each. We don't see outputs except environment? It says environment applies verifier and shows resulting gold pair to student. We can call multiple. We should ensure inputs valid and rectangular 10x10. We can generate manually.

Important: If interior contains exactly two non-zero, non-5 colors. Border one-thick rectangle of 5. Need min/max rows and cols match border. We can choose border row range e.g. rows 2..7, cols 2..7 as example. Interior rows 3..6, cols 3..6 (4x4). Fill with two colors e.g. 1 and 2 and 0. Outside fill random colors but should include same two maybe. But verifier only swaps inside. If outside has 5? Actually if any 5 outside could alter min max. Avoid 5 outside. Use 0 and various colors 1-4? But if outside includes the two interior colors, unchanged (important to show). If outside includes other colors, unchanged too.
